On the actual published anti-corruption parent, raw2B output began with denial but then incorrectly allowed a monetary gift. Mechanical source/keyword checks had passed; manual reading failed it. Full-corpus raw failure is preserved in policies-rag-evaluation-final.json. Runtime must return the whole literal normative parent without generation for direct permission/prohibition/duty questions.

limitations: Mechanical citation checks cannot prove semantic faithfulness
Full published-corpus retrieval, ACL, injection and negative cases require separate integration evaluation
